lines.t: Hmm, hmm, hmm, hmm, hmm, hmm, hmm
I heard a whisper in the dry wind call
Through the cracks of every broken wall
Said the hearts of men done wandered far
Chasing shadows, forgetting who they are
The feet keep walking down them crooked roads
Hands still clutching every heavy load
Truth been knocking but they turn away
Trade the lie just to rule the day
The silence speaks when no one listens
The fire fades without submission
Voices in the wind still crying out
Truth don't bend just to fit your doubt
You can run, but it won't let go
It's the seed of his soul, my soul
Voices in the wind, hear it rise
Calling every heart to open eyes
Kings and prophets try to make it clear
Still the people choose what they want to hear
Building kingdoms on sinking sand
While the truth slips right through their hands
Every warning like a distant drum
Still they dance like the end won't come
But the rhythm of the truth stands strong
Even when the whole world sings it wrong
You can't hide from what is spoken
Every lie will leave you broken
Voices in the wind still crying out
Truth don't bend just to fit your doubt
You can run but it won't let go
It's the seed of your soul, my soul
Voices in the wind, hear it rise
Calling every heart to open eyes
Strip it down, let the silence speak
Truth ain't found in the proud or weak
It's a fire burning deep inside
But you gotta lay your will aside
A drum talk say, hear the call now
A guitar cry, don't you fall now
Feet move but the soul stand still
Truth remain whether you will or will
Voices in the wind still crying out
Truth don't bend just to fit your doubt
When the noise of the world all fades
Only truth gonna light your way
Voices in the wind, loud and clear
Still the voice many refuse to hear
Yet the winds still carry that sound
Truth still rise when it's buried down
You can fight it, you can turn away
But it's waiting at the end of every day
Bye.
